chapter: Dancers, Newton, Chu Berry and the Cab Calloway band
title: Chu Berry as humanitarian

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: You said that he was a great humanitarian. In what way?

Well he would help, I've seen him help a lot of tenor players. I've seen him help musicians. On a lot of things, talk, recommend them on jobs and help 'em. I've seen him sit down and help them with their music. They would come up and ask him different questions from being out on the road, you know, not only tenor players, trumpet players and trombone players sit down because Chu was very popular. They'd come up and start talking to Chu and he would take his own time to sit down and talk to them and I think that that was very nice trait in him to do that. Just take his own time, sit down and explain to them this and that. And that's the reason I called him humanitarian, because I've seen him do so many different things regarding the wellbeing of somebody else.
